title: Borrow, don't copy
prompt: Implement `int count_vowels(const std::string& text)` taking the string by `const&` (no copy) and returning the number of vowels a e i o u (case-insensitive).

tests.name: mixed
tests.hint: o, a, i — count each once.

tests.name: empty
tests.hint: The empty string borrows fine; zero vowels.
